whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Abhiruchi Marwari Vaasa Bhojnalay,

I noticed your legendary 1940 heritage bhojnalay has solid 3.9★ reviews on Fraser Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for daily thali menus and table bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp takeaway ordering, authentic Marwari thali menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/abhiruchi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Abhiruchi Marwari Vaasa Bhojnalay, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke heritage restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with your authentic Marwari thali menu, Fraser Road location directions, and direct WhatsApp takeaway ordering. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact daily menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
